description: A complete mobile progressive web app (PWA) for administering a Linux server without ever opening an SSH terminal. It centralizes management of web sites (Nginx), Docker containers, backups and restores (local, USB/SSD, and Google Drive), real-time system monitoring (CPU, RAM, disk, temperature), Debian/OS package management, network and security, installed services (Tailscale, Docker, PM2), and Node.js processes — all from a phone, securely over Tailscale. Multiple independent deployments (e.g. a Pi + an Ubuntu server) can be saved and switched between from the same interface.

api.title: apps/api — Backend
api.description: Fastify (Node.js): serves the REST/WebSocket API and the built frontend. JWT + 2FA (TOTP) authentication, Docker control (dockerode), monitoring (systeminformation), backups, Google Drive, scheduling (node-cron).

web.title: apps/web — Frontend
web.description: React + Vite, installable PWA (manifest + service worker). Mobile-first interface with hamburger-menu navigation.

shared.title: packages/shared — Shared types
shared.description: TypeScript types shared between the API and the frontend (DTOs, WebSocket protocol).

deploy.title: deploy/ — Deployment
deploy.description: systemd unit, scoped sudoers rules (least privilege), install and certificate renewal scripts.

modules.dashboard: Overview: CPU, RAM, disk, temperature, connected USB/SSD drive, and active alerts at a glance.
modules.docker: Containers, images, volumes, and networks: start, stop, live logs and stats, image export/import, volume backup.
modules.nginx: Vhosts, enable/disable, validated configuration editing, certificates, accessibility, traffic, config backup, per-site maintenance mode.
modules.sites: Aggregated per-site view combining Nginx info and associated Docker containers.
modules.os: System information, installed packages, Debian/apt updates with live progress tracking.
modules.pm2: Node.js processes managed by PM2 directly on the host: status, live logs, start/stop/restart.
modules.network: Open ports, IP blocking (fail2ban), hardware (model, voltage, IP, Wi-Fi, SSH), system services.
modules.applications: Composite full backups (containers + folders + Docker volumes + database), full or partial, local/USB/Google Drive.
modules.backups: Creation and deletion of volume, folder, and database backups — local, USB, or Google Drive.
modules.restore: Guided 3-step restore (source → archive → confirmation), the app's only entry point for restoring data.
modules.system: Detailed monitoring: temperature, throttling, disks, network, operating system.
modules.services: Status and updates for services installed on the server (Tailscale, Docker, PM2).
modules.settings: Administrator account, 2FA activation, audit log of all sensitive actions.

security: No shell command built by string concatenation (argv-array only).
Elevated privileges strictly scoped via sudoers, the service is never run as root.
JWT + 2FA (TOTP) authentication, audit log of every destructive action.
Network access exclusively via Tailscale (private VPN) — never exposed publicly.
storageDescription: Local (server disk), external USB/SSD drive (auto-detected and mounted), and/or Google Drive (personal account via OAuth2), configurable per backup. Restoring is always done from the Restore screen, regardless of the original source.
